title: World Bloom — To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage — Episode9 Dreams Carried On

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage
meta.Event Outline: On MORE MORE JUMP!'s first free day in quite some time, they have been enjoying school life to the full. Their recent TV appearance has caused a buzz among their classmates, renewing their determination to keep working their hardest. That's when they each find themselves in an unfamiliar part of SEKAI...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... Th-The light's finally gone...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But... Wait, where'd Miku go?
Also, where am I?
Hmm... No matter how many times I try, I still can't get it right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That voice...
It's the same as that flower's...!

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
But I have to keep trying... Again!
One, two, three and... Turn here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, that little girl...

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
So, um...!
I've been watching lots and lots of your videos at home... And I loved how sparkly you were today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She was at our solo show. She's the one who came to talk to me...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And this dance routine she's doing...)

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
How'd I do, Daddy?!
Did I get it right?

rows.Speaker: Girl's Father
rows.Line:
Yes, you nailed it.
I think that's your best attempt yet!

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
No, Daddy!
You gotta be a lot harsher than that!

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line: At this rate, I'm never going to become like Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I knew it. That's the dance for one of our songs.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(She's been practicing how to do it...
Ever since we met.)

rows.Speaker: Girl's Father
rows.Line:
Hahaha. Alright, pumpkin.
Still, you really can't get enough of Minori, can you?

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
No, I can't!
How many times do I have to tell you?!

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line: I'm gonna become a super sparkly idol who makes everyone smile! Just like her! And...

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line: We're gonna sing together someday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
You were really, really pretty.
That's why I...

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
I want to become an idol just like you!
So, let's sing together someday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(What she said that time...
She's been staying true to her word ever since...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Like when I was little...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I started practicing like there was no tomorrow after seeing Haruka that time because I really wanted to sing with her.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And now...)
No, this is nothing like how Haruka dances it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line:
I have to try a lot harder.
Think more about how Haruka moves...!

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line:
No, it looks all wrong!
It's the exact same choreography, but why am I all over the place?

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: At this rate, I'm never going to get to stand on stage with Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(That takes me back.
I kept practicing like this until not too long ago.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I failed all those auditions...
And I felt like giving up each time I did.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But Haruka always gave me the strength to stand back up each day and believe that tomorrow will be a better day. I kept practicing as much as I could...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That was the moment I finally felt like I achieved my dream of becoming an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I have to keep trying...
I'm going to become just like Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Little Minori
rows.Line: I'm going to become an idol no matter what...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I wish you the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're probably going to face a lot of challenges and be put in some tough situations in the future...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But as long as you keep trying like you are now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: As long as you keep believing that you're going to become an idol someday, you'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And someday...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Your dream of singing on a big, spectacular stage with your best friends will come true!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Minori!
Minori...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wait, you're all here...?!
How?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We saw a really bright flash, so we decided to see what caused it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That was where we found you and Miku frantically calling your name.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I was so worried...
You stopped responding to me after being engulfed by that light...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry!
I started seeing another person's thoughts and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I knew it. That light also allowed you to see another person's thoughts, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What...?!
Does that mean all of you...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
We all experienced something similar.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We all were engulfed in light just like you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So...
What did you see while in that light, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
I saw this little girl who said she also wanted to become an idol, and me practicing really hard when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
A little girl who wants to become an idol...?
Are you talking about the one from your solo show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
She reminded me of myself when I was little. I saw her practicing really hard and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I felt really glad that I never decided to give up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Things were really tough until not too long ago... I really had to endure a lot...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But because I kept on trying, I was able to take the necessary steps to make my dream of becoming an idol possible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Obviously, I still have lots and lots to learn!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I feel that my past self and those who I've been able to spread hope to are there to encourage and push me forward now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I'm going to keep doing what I've been doing, and spread hope to as many people as I can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wanna keep leaping forward as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You really are a wonderful idol, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're earnest and always trying your best...
That's why I believe you've become an enormous source of encouragement for a lot of people.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I absolutely believe that your dream of performing at the Dome will come true!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that is the sort of declaration we like to hear.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and we're among those people you've given hope to, Minori, so we more or less understand how that little girl you met feels.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But we're also not about to let you take all the credit for spreading hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's all keep doing our best on that front together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Let's!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It's so nice of you all to say that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you so much!!!
I'm standing here now because of all of you, so I promise to also keep doing my best...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-So, umm...
I look forward to keep working with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course.
We look forward to doing the same.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh?
Did one of your phones just go off?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, it's mine!
I got a message. But from who...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What...?!
From Chi...?!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link_idol_ed4
